description: Apply only an existing reviewed preview with exact expectedVersion, confirmation:true and stable idempotencyKey. Never apply before the user confirms its effects. Replaying the same unknown operation requires reconciliation; a new key must not replay its uncertain external step. An older unknown receipt does not block a new independently confirmed operation. Read current state before preparing new changes. Summarize receipts in chat. For a pending channel attempt, show beautyos_channel_setup_link with the returned salonId, channelType and attemptId; never restart it just to show setup.
name: beautyos_apply_change
title: Apply confirmed changes
